intro: Denver mixes an old-school Russian banya that has been running since 1927 with a wave of newer community sauna and cold-plunge spots, several of them outdoors next to breweries and yoga studios.

venues.name: Lake Steam Baths
venues.schedule: Single-gender, nude (swimwear allowed). Men: Wed, Fri, Sat 8:30 AM-10 PM; Sun 6 AM-9 PM. Women: Mon & Thu 8:30 AM-9 PM. Closed Tue. No co-ed days.
venues.notes: Operating since 1927. Sells veniki (oak branches). No refunds; ask for a tour before paying.

venues.name: Red Rock Sauna (at Hogshead Brewery)
venues.schedule: Mixed, up to 10 per session. Mon & Fri 7-11 AM and 4-9 PM; Tue-Thu 4-9 PM; Sat-Sun 7 AM-8 PM. Walk-ins if spots are open.
venues.notes: Swimsuit or athletic wear required. Changing tent provided.

venues.name: Garden Sauna
venues.schedule: Mixed, shared space. Sun 9 AM-2 PM & 4-9 PM; Mon, Wed-Fri 4-9 PM; Sat 10 AM-7 PM; closed Tue. Last session starts 1 hour before close.
venues.notes: Enter through Rooted Heart Yoga. Swimwear and towel required.

venues.name: Therma Haus
venues.schedule: Mixed. Mon & Wed 4-8:30 PM; Tue, Thu, Fri 6-11:30 AM & 4-8:30 PM; Sat-Sun 8 AM-1:30 PM & 4-8:30 PM.
venues.notes: Two cedar saunas, phone-free. Free garage parking in the AMLI Art District building.

venues.name: PORTAL° Thermaculture Denver
venues.schedule: Mixed; 18+. Sun 8 AM-10 PM; Mon, Wed-Fri 7 AM-10 PM; Tue 2-10 PM; Sat 8 AM-10 PM.
venues.notes: Two saunas. Venue site does not say how many credits one session costs.
